title: Sports and Hobbies
text:
Tom likes football. He plays football every Saturday with his friends in the park. They play for one hour. Tom is a good player, and his friends like to play with him.

Anna likes swimming. She goes to the pool on Monday and Thursday. Swimming makes her happy and strong. After the pool, she always eats an apple.

questions.text: What does Tom play every Saturday?
How often does Anna go to the pool?
Why does Tom probably enjoy playing with his friends?
options: He likes spending time with them
He lives far from the park

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel after swimming?

having a lot of physical power
a place with water where people swim

paragraph_translations: Том любить футбол. Щосуботи він грає у футбол з друзями в парку. Вони грають одну годину. Том — добрий гравець, і його друзі люблять грати з ним.
Анна любить плавання. Вона ходить у басейн у понеділок і четвер. Плавання робить її щасливою і сильною. Після басейну вона завжди їсть яблуко.
